amp> refractory on
refractory: on
amp> b, o, k = population 8
b: 8 members, b{1..8}, all individuals
o: 8 members, o{1..8}, all individuals
k: 8 members, k{1..8}, all individuals
amp> book = <b -> o -> o -> k>
book: <b, o, o, k> and transition b -> o -> o -> k
amp> invoke b, o, o, k
moment   active   refractory   why
1        b
2        o        b            o: expected by book b -> o
3        o        o            o: expected by book o -> o
4        k        o            k: expected by book o -> k
5                 k
incomplete   book <b, o, o, k>   at most 2 of 4
